hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git reset --hard|git push --force|git clean -fd'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command blocked. Requires explicit user confirmation. Run with: ! <command>"}}'; fi

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$fp" in *schema.graphql|*graphql.ts) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Auto-generated file. Regenerate via: dotnet build (backend) or pnpm codegen (frontend)"}}';; esac
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$fp" in *.ts|*.tsx) pnpm --filter frontend run lint -- --fix 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$fp" in *.md) prettier --write "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$fp" in .claude/*|.github/*) echo "$(date -Iseconds) Changed: $fp" >> .claude/friction-log.md;; esac
